coverage: Every prescribed exactly shared saved physical time, complete nested bilinear reconstructions at all fine nodes; full first1801 integer seconds plus complete common minute samples and explicitly separate unshared endpoint rows.
time_settings_change: All three tolerances divided by10 AND max_step60s reduced to30s; not a tolerance-only change.
root_difference: Report separately in seconds; no dimensionless field threshold is applied to roots.
interpretation: Fixed engineering inter-grid/inter-setting targets. Failure must remain accuracy_passed=false in the final report. These are neither continuous-PDE error bounds nor guarantees that every four-decimal string is identical.
integration_policy: Completion of the approved FV matrix/comparisons and evaluation of these fixed criteria is mandatory. A false FV accuracy outcome is retained and reported, never renamed PASS; higher-order FE evidence is reported independently and cannot relabel FV as meeting the target.
